title: Hypopyon Ulcer, Acanthamoeba and Sterile Infiltrates

steps.tx: **Hypopyon corneal ulcer** in severe form historically meant pneumococcal creeping ulcer in elderly dacryocystitis patients, serpiginous spread with hypopyon and perforation risk. Modern hypopyon remains severity sign across bacterial and fungal ulcers needing sac assessment as source. Chronic sac reservoir reinfects cornea until drainage treated, linking lacrimal and cornea modules causally.
steps.say: Layered pus together gives severity across ulcer types needing sac source assessment in elderly patients at presentation. Reservoir treatment gives recurrence prevention additionally. Creeping history gives pneumococcal context.

steps.tx: **Acanthamoeba keratitis** infects contact lens wearers exposed to water, pain out of proportion to signs early, pseudodendrite, then ring infiltrate and perineuritis late. Diagnosis delays because herpes assumption treats pseudodendrite while amoeba advances. Confocal microscopy or culture on special media confirms where suspicion voiced early enough to request them.
steps.say: Lens water exposure together gives amoeba suspicion with pain beyond signs in wearers characteristically over weeks. Herpes assumption gives delay danger additionally. Early suspicion gives test requesting.

steps.tx: **Ring infiltrate** is late amoeba sign but also immune ring in bacterial or fungal disease, so ring alone never diagnoses organism without exposure and pain context. Steroids worsen amoeba dramatically as herpes dendrite, shared lesson that suppression before organism control harms protozoal and viral ulcers alike. Lens water history therefore precedes steroid in every wearer ulcer.
steps.say: Ring context together gives organism direction beyond shape alone in wearer ulcers at assessment in specialist clinics over time. Steroid worsening gives shared protozoal lesson. Water history gives prescribing gate.

steps.tx: Sterile infiltrates from contact lens inflammation, marginal hypersensitivity or post surgical immune response mimic infection with milder pain, smaller size and intact epithelium clues. Culture negative course and steroid responsiveness after infection exclusion separate them retrospectively. **Intact epithelium** over infiltrate lowers infection priority substantially at slit lamp sorting.
steps.say: Intact epithelium together gives sterile priority lowering in infiltrate sorting at slit lamp during lens clinic assessment in wearers. Milder pain gives supporting weight additionally. Exclusion gives steroid safety.

steps.tx: **Perineuritis** radial nerve inflammation around amoeba cysts explains disproportionate pain anatomically, tenderness tracing nerve paths beyond visible infiltrate. Pain narrative therefore localises amoeba before ring appears in disease timeline. Analgesia need out of proportion is documented as diagnostic data, not symptom exaggeration, in amoeba clerking.

steps.tx: Amoeba therapy is prolonged antiseptic based with cyst resistance explaining months course and late surgery for scar or perforation after organism clearance. steps.tx: Endophthalmitis risk after perforation converts ulcer care to intraocular emergency with vitreous assessment and intravitreal pathways from uveitis batch. Sealed perforation with formed chamber and quiet vitreous observes differently from open leak with vitreous inflammation. **Vitreous view** at ulcer perforation decides which emergency ladder begins.

steps.tx: Anchors: hypopyon grades and sources, amoeba hurts beyond signs in wet lens wearers, sterile keeps epithelium and steroids wait organisms. Ring needs context, pain narrates nerves and sac reinfects cornea. **Water history** is amoeba gate question in every lens ulcer clerking.
steps.say: Pain pattern together gives amoeba direction while hypopyon gives sac source search in ulcer clinics for wearers and elderly. Water history gives gate questioning always. Organism control gives steroid timing.
